notes.title: New Ability: Hints
notes.notes:
Hello dear adventurers!

We’ve heard your feedback, and we’re excited to introduce a new hint system to the game! This feature will help you find those waifus who’ve truly earned an S+ in hiding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747108/0365083a014180ff19d0dc31d5946069dcf88938.png[/img]

You’ll unlock the hint ability after leaving the third room or beyond.

Additionally, we’ve implemented a new system that tracks fun stats for your individual save file, now viewable in the new stats menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747108/b0269d95e38cbfb2637348e9b58d872c5c7840d4.png[/img]

Here are some more notable changes in this update:
[list]
[*] Added background animation to the Leaderboards menu.
[*] Reduced the volume of Ursula's moans.
[*] Fixed the Edge Screen Panning settings option to work as intended.
[*] Screen dragging speed is now consistent across all levels.
[/list]

Thank you so much for supporting us, and we hope you enjoy this new update!

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers!

We're incredibly happy with the positive reception of the game and want to thank you all from the bottom of our hearts!

Today, we're releasing a small patch with some improvements:
[list]
[*] Fixed keys not triggering the clear screen if they were the last thing revealed.
[*] Adjusted the timing for some intimate animations.
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Tower of Hidden Waifus is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h2]It's finally here! Tower of Hidden Waifus is now live and ready for you to explore.[/h2]

Discover the mystery of the tower located in Drumna, a small village in the west of Soleborn, where residents have been tormented by the "demons" of the tower, screaming and roaring at night, disturbing their peace.

Embark on this exciting adventure to find the hidden waifus, save the imprisoned ones, and expect to be rewarded in pleasurable ways! Can you be the one adventurer to make it out successfully?

Thank you for all your support and patience—now go have a blast!

notes.title: Coming out today!
notes.notes:
[h2]Today is the big day, everyone![/h2]

[h3]Tower of Hidden Waifus launches today, July 30, at:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 9:00 AM PDT (Pacific Daylight Time)
[*] 6:00 PM CEST (Central European Summer Time)
[*] 1:00 AM JST (Japan Standard Time, July 31)
[/list]

We're really excited for you to finally get your hands on the game and dive into the adventure we've put so much into creating. It's been a long journey of non-stop work, and now that it's time to release it, we can't help but feel a mix of excitement and nervousness!

See you in a bit, stay tuned!

notes.title: Release Date Shift
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you so much for your interest in our game!

Throughout the development, this game became more and more ambitious, requiring much more time and care than we initially anticipated. As such, the release will have to be postponed a bit. We are really sorry about this, but there are some good news as well:

A good percentage of the progress has been shared on our Patreon, however, there's so much more going on in the background.

For example, we've substantially increased the number of lines of dialogue, level detail, waifu variation. We've added tons of new features such as choices, adaptive dialogues, multiple endings, multiple save files, etc., as well as moving to a new audio engine to support better effects. Many of those changes will be reflected in the store page, with a new trailer and description on the way.

We are just two developers, and although it's a ton of work, we are incredibly happy with what we've been able to achieve so far. We're now at a point where the base is pretty much complete, and we can focus on adding content.

We hope you like how it all sounds. We expect the actual release to be in about a month or two, but the exact date will be announced in a later post.

We'll keep everyone updated! Thank you!
